What's Inside

Full Feature Set

Everything a real e-commerce store needs — built the right way with Laravel conventions.

🏠
Dynamic Home Page

Full-screen hero with featured product card, animated marquee ticker, product grid pulled from database, and category browsing.

👟
Product Catalog

12 seeded Nike shoes with category filter, price range filter, and sort (price low/high, newest). Each product has gallery images, sizes, and colors.

🛒
Session-Based Cart

Add to bag from any page, adjust quantity, remove items. Cart persists across pages. Live badge counter in navbar. Free shipping over Rs. 15,000.

💳
3-Method Checkout

Credit/Debit Card, Easypaisa, and Cash on Delivery. All fields validated server-side in Laravel with specific error messages per field.

📦
Order Management

Orders saved to MySQL with full detail. Stock auto-decrements. Confirmation email sent via Laravel Mail. Success page with order summary.

📬
Working Contact Form

Server-side validated contact form sends real email to umerahsan696@gmail.com via Gmail SMTP using Laravel Mailables.

🔐
Admin Authentication

Session-based admin login with custom AdminAuth middleware protecting all /admin/* routes. Wrong credentials show specific field-level error messages.

📊
Yajra DataTables

Server-side DataTables for Products, Orders, Order Items, and Customers. Full search, sort, and pagination — all via AJAX endpoints.

💰
PKR Currency

All prices displayed in Pakistani Rupees (Rs. format) with 17% GST calculation and free/paid shipping thresholds built in.

Getting Started

Quick Setup

Get the store running locally in under 5 minutes.

1

Install Dependencies

Make sure you have PHP 8.1+, Composer, and MySQL installed.

bash
composer install
2

Configure Environment

Copy the example env file and generate your app key.

bash
cp .env.example .env php artisan key:generate
3

Setup Database

Create a MySQL database named nike_pakistan, then update your .env:

.env
DB_DATABASE=nike_pakistan DB_USERNAME=root DB_PASSWORD=your_password
4

Migrate & Seed

Run migrations and seed the database with 12 products and sample orders.

bash
php artisan migrate --seed
5

Start the Server

Launch the development server and open in your browser.

bash
php artisan serve

Visit → http://localhost:8000

6

Setup Email (Optional)

To enable real email sending (order confirmations & contact form), add your Gmail App Password to .env:

.env
MAIL_USERNAME=umerahsan696@gmail.com MAIL_PASSWORD=your_gmail_app_password

Get an App Password at → myaccount.google.com/apppasswords

Routes & Pages

All Pages

Every page and its route in the application.

routes/web.php
// ── Public Store ────────────────────── GET / → Home page (featured products) GET /products → All products (filter + sort) GET /products/{id} → Single product detail GET /cart → Shopping cart page POST /cart/add → Add item to cart (AJAX) PATCH /cart/update/{id} → Update quantity (AJAX) DELETE /cart/remove/{id} → Remove item (AJAX) GET /checkout → Checkout form POST /checkout → Place order (validated) GET /order/success/{id} → Order confirmation page GET /contact → Contact page POST /contact → Send email via Laravel Mail // ── Admin Panel ─────────────────────── GET /admin/login → Admin login form POST /admin/login → Authenticate admin POST /admin/logout → Logout GET /admin → Dashboard + stats GET /admin/products → Products DataTable GET /admin/products/create→ Add new product PUT /admin/products/{id}→ Update product DELETE /admin/products/{id}→ Delete product GET /admin/orders → Orders DataTable GET /admin/orders/{id} → Order detail + status update GET /admin/order-items → Order line items DataTable GET /admin/users → Customers DataTable

DataTables (Yajra)

All admin tables use Yajra Laravel DataTables with server-side processing, search, sort, and pagination.

  • Products Table — Product image, name, category, price in PKR, stock level (with ⚠ warning when low), in/out-of-stock badge, Edit & Delete actions
  • Orders Table — Order ID, customer name, email, item count, subtotal, total, status badge (color-coded), date, View button
  • Order Items Table — Line items linked to orders with size, color, quantity, unit price, and total
  • Customers Table — All users who have placed an order, with city, province, total orders count, and total amount spent

Order Status Management

Click View on any order to see full detail and update its status through the full lifecycle:

PENDING → PROCESSING → SHIPPED → DELIVERED | CANCELLED

Product CRUD

Full Create, Read, Update, Delete for products from the admin panel with fields for name, subtitle, category, price, old price (sale badge auto-calculated), stock, description, colors, sizes, and image URLs.

Database Schema

MySQL Tables
products — id, name, subtitle, category, price, old_price, description, rating, stock, badge, colors (JSON), sizes (JSON), images (JSON) orders — id, order_number, customer_name, customer_email, customer_phone, address, city, province, postal_code, payment_method, subtotal, shipping, tax, total, status, notes order_items — id, order_id, product_id, product_name, size, color, quantity, unit_price, total_price customers — id, name, email, phone, city, province, total_orders, total_spent
